style.name: Sand und Indigo, Siebdruck
style.directive: Flat screen-print illustration on warm sand paper. Limited palette of sand, ochre, burnt red and deep indigo shadows. Visible fine grain, no gradients. Confident dark outlines, flat fills. Side-on or slightly elevated views with calm horizons and generous empty space. People only as reduced modern stick figures without facial features.
